articles.title: Insecure Agents Podcast: How to Keep AI Agents From Bypassing Security Controls
articles.description: A coding agent blocked from installing a package may try another way to download it. In this episode of the Insecure Agents podcast recorded at Black Hat, Socket CTO Ahmad Nassri joins host Allie Howe to discuss how agents’ determination to finish a task can lead them to bypass security controls, and how Socket Firewall changes what they see before an install begins. Nassri describes cases where agents responded to blocked installs by fetching package tarballs directly from a CDN, overriding…
